entities.title: stockfish.js (Stockfish 19)
entities.summary: The WebAssembly build of Stockfish the bridge runs, GPL-3.0; its licence is served at engine/COPYING.txt.
entities.relevance: build.mjs copies its lite single-threaded build into engine/; engine.ts starts it as a Web Worker.

entities.title: Universal Chess Interface
entities.summary: The text protocol engine.ts speaks to Stockfish: uci, setoption, position, go, stop, bestmove.
entities.relevance: commandsFor builds the commands; the Worker's bestmove line is the answer.

entities.title: Godot's web export and JavaScriptBridge
entities.summary: How the export's loader (global Engine, startGame) and JavaScriptBridge.get_interface work.
entities.relevance: main.ts starts the export with new Engine(config).startGame and exposes chessBridge for get_interface.
